original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳前议长称曾阻止特别检察官逮捕Bawku Central议员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳前议长Aaron Mike Oquaye教授披露，他在任议长期间曾介入阻止时任特别检察官对Bawku Central选区议员Mahama Ayariga的逮捕行动。该说法来自单一来源报道，尚未获得其他方面证实。

key_facts.fact: 加纳前议长Mike Oquaye称曾阻止特别检察官逮捕Bawku Central议员Mahama Ayariga
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former Speaker of Parliament, Prof. Aaron Mike Oquaye, has revealed how he intervened to stop the then Special Prosecutor from pursuing the arrest of Bawku Central MP, Mahama Ayariga, during his tenure as Speaker.

uncertainties: 该说法目前仅来自单一来源报道，尚未获得特别检察官办公室或其他方面证实
事件具体时间与细节未获独立核实
